units.source_text: 黎明时分这么寒峭，岛村有点意外。

en.t: Shimamura was a little surprised that it was so sharply cold at dawn.

units.source_text: 他从枕边抬起头，望见天空仍是一片夜色，可是山峦已经微微发白了。

en.t: He lifted his head from the pillow and saw that the sky was still dark as night, but the mountains had already begun to pale faintly.
